items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I sat and listened with him, as he transcribed the lyrics to me

ctx.x: Steely Dan, right. And I think Pat Coyle, the pianist of in that season, said, Man, these changes are beautiful and we're going to dig all this within, so I sat and listened with him, as he transcribed the lyrics to me and the whole thing. And I said, "Yeah, that's really quite lovely." And I got back to -- well, actually I hadn't heard Vinandi-
yet then play them from Dick La Palm, but when I did, I said, 'Yeah, I'm aware of the pieces and I think it's a good idea.' Because it was basically Dick's idea to do the Steely Dan thing.
